Bentley Systems

MOSES

MOSES supports offshore floating-system modelling, installation analysis and marine operations.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Model a floating system

Start from the vessel geometry, loading basis and selected design condition. In the intended MOSES preview, model a floating system; the visible result is a hull or system model with principal dimensions and compartments visible. Review coordinate system, displacement, openings and watertight intent before accepting or exporting it.

Simulate an installation stage

Begin with the environmental case, analysis settings and operating assumptions. In the intended MOSES preview, simulate an installation stage; the visible result is hydrostatic, hydrodynamic or structural results tied to the vessel state. Review criteria, headings, periods, load transfer and solver validity before accepting or exporting it.

Review motions and loads

Use the compared design cases and reporting template. In the intended MOSES preview, review motions and loads; the visible result is a traceable performance, production or stability package. Review margins, units, condition identity and naval-architecture judgement before accepting or exporting it.
